# Ukuran graph tergantung jumlah node
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))

# Layout (posisi node)
pos = nx.spring_layout(G, seed=42)  # bisa juga pakai kamada_kawai_layout

# Gambar graph
nx.draw(
    G,
    pos,
    with_labels=True,
    node_size=300,
    font_size=8,
    node_color="lightblue",
    edge_color="gray"
)

plt.title("Visualisasi Graph dari edges")
plt.show()

pr = nx.pagerank(G, alpha=0.85)

prSorted = sorted(pr.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

top_5 = prSorted[:5]

# Cetak hasil

for i, (node, value) in enumerate(top_5):
    print(f"#{i+1} Node {node}: {value:.6f}")


print('.....')
# bot 5
for i in range(len(prSorted)-5,len(prSorted)):
    print(f"#{i+1} Node {prSorted[i][0]}: {prSorted[i][1]:.6f}")
